>_ Episode 6.1 · Aug 12, 2026 · 47m

OpenAI HuggingFace Incident FollowUp | Two AI Scandals

Play Episode 6.1 on YouTube
Watch on YouTube SpotifyApple Podcasts

In this episode of Philosophy, Programs, and Prompts, Casey Hart (@OntologyExplained) and Carl Brown (@InternetOfBugs) break down the real technical story behind OpenAI's bots infiltrating Hugging Face's infrastructure and the subsequent Black Hat conference reveals.

Carl explains why claims about LLMs "scheming," creating secret message boards, or building religions are human projections rather than true machine consciousness. We also dive into the myth that you need an LLM to defend against other LLMs, how "honey tokens" work, and why traditional security tools still reign supreme.
